title: Shivneri Fort

terrainReference.basis: Original field at the geographic anchor on the fort hill.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap Shivneri Fort property, Archaeological Survey of India public visitor coordinates and Overture roof controls
mapIdentity.scope: Current OpenStreetMap way 198116052 gives the named property and neighboring trails and cliff lines. Public Archaeological Survey of India e-walk coordinates place the seven named gates, shrine and summit structures. Two observed Google Open Buildings polygons are used as local size and orientation constraints where they agree with the official visitor locations. The older OSM birthplace point conflicts with the current official visitor guide and is not used.

note: The Archaeological Survey’s gate sequence, Maharashtra tourism descriptions, the 1912 eyewitness record of pointed masonry gates, the two rows of vaults and sculpted shrine, and the Parliamentary Secretariat’s written description of the two-storey birthplace establish the principal forms. The 2007 Qualla photograph confirms the exposed double scarp and dark gray-tan masonry palette on the upland silhouette.
